characters.name: Austin
characters.clueEn: He was not beside a table.

characters.name: Benton
characters.clueEn: He was in the bottom row.

characters.name: Dawn
characters.clueEn: She was east of Benton. She was not beside a table.
characters.clueZh: 她在Benton的东边。她不在桌子旁边。

characters.name: Elodie
characters.clueEn: She was in the Basement. She was not beside the TV.
characters.clueZh: 她在地下室。她不在电视旁边。

characters.name: Fred
characters.clueEn: He was alone. He was sitting in a chair.
characters.clueZh: 他独自一人。他坐在椅子上。

characters.name: Vin
characters.clueEn: The Victim. He was alone with the murderer.
characters.clueZh: 被害者。和凶手单独在一起。

generalClues.textEn: There was exactly one person on the bed.

generalClues.text: 只有两个人坐在椅子上。
generalClues.textEn: There were exactly two people sitting in a chair.
